auth.why: To read your receipt and invoice emails so recurring subscriptions can be detected. Read-only: the connector never sends, replies to, forwards, labels, archives, or deletes any email.

description: Finds every recurring subscription hiding in your Gmail receipts, walks you through cancelling the ones you don't want, and tracks what you save. Flat fee: $10 per completed cancellation, charged only when you confirm the savings.

proactive_triggers.description: Repeat receipt emails from the same merchant detected in Gmail

tools.description: Scan Gmail for subscription receipts and detect recurring subscriptions
tools.name: scan_subscriptions

tools.description: List tracked subscriptions, optionally filtered by status
tools.name: list_subscriptions

tools.description: Update a subscription: status, confirmed monthly savings, or notes
tools.name: update_subscription

tools.description: Get the step-by-step cancellation pack (curated steps + direct link) for a subscription
tools.name: get_cancel_pack

tools.description: Set up billing: Stripe customer + SetupIntent to save a card (no charge taken)
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Confirm savings for cancelled subscriptions; charges the $10-per-cancellation fee off-session
tools.name: confirm_savings

webhooks.recurring_charge_detected: Fired when repeat receipt emails from the same merchant are detected; agent sends the proactive nudge and offers the one-tap cancel walkthrough.
